svg.title: The water cycle
svg.desc: The water cycle: evaporation from the sea, transpiration from plants, condensation into clouds, precipitation, surface run-off, infiltration and groundwater flow back to the sea.

g.data-info: Provides the energy that drives the water cycle.
Water vapour rises, cools and condenses into tiny droplets: clouds.
Liquid water from oceans, lakes and soil changes to water vapour.
Plants lose water vapour from their leaves (evapotranspiration together with evaporation).
Droplets join and fall as rain, snow or hail.
Water flows over the ground into streams and rivers and back to the sea.
Water soaks into the soil and rock and flows slowly underground to rivers and the sea.

g.text: wind carries clouds inland; air cools as it rises
